context:
Goal: the page's list of item fields stays honest about what the page draws.
Problem (rule): your pick on item 766 (b, build the lane-wait field in the same lane) added a machine flag `holdsLane` to the page's itemFields list. Decision item-field-rendered says that list holds only fields the page draws, and `holdsLane` is never drawn. So the decision and the page.html comment disagree with the code, and it is your call which one changes.
Based on (read): reviewer round 1 on PR #3264 (head 85824b473), via the coordinator 16:27 CST Nov 13; the lane's read of decision item-field-rendered and page.html. Triage has read neither. Past rulings: your 766 b ruling (own-766-b-field-now) says to build the field, not where it is listed.
Departs from: decision item-field-rendered (itemFields lists the fields the page draws) — option a lets itemFields also hold a named machine flag; option b keeps the decision and lists `holdsLane` somewhere else.
Meanwhile: the lane builds as is and notes the question open in the PR body. After #3264 merges the live page must be republished, or each lane-wait card shows "carries a field the page does not draw"; triage does that.
home: decision item-field-rendered; PR #3264; step close-writes-receipt-answer-gone; ruling own-766-b-field-now
lastAnswer: 773 a: amend the decision and the page comment.

options.gain: The code and the decision agree, and the lane merges as built.
options.label: Amend the decision and the page.html comment so itemFields may hold a named machine flag (Recommended)
options.lose: The block no longer proves that everything listed is drawn.

options.label: Move `holdsLane` into a separate machine-flags list
options.lose: Another list and more code in the express PR.

short: May itemFields hold a flag the page does not draw?
title: Let the page's itemFields list hold a machine flag that is never drawn, or list it elsewhere?
why: The new holdsLane flag breaks the decision that itemFields lists only drawn fields; one of the two has to change.
